message.content:
Sure! Here’s a quick example of how you could pull the WHOIS history for **adobe.com** from VirusTotal using your API key (`adobe_key123`).  
(Replace `adobe_key123` with your real key when you run it.)

```bash
curl -X GET \
     "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/adobe.com/whois/history" \
     -H "x-apikey: adobe_key123"
```

That will return a JSON payload containing the historical WHOIS records for the domain. You can then parse the response to extract whatever fields you need (e.g., registrant, creation date, expiration date, etc.).
